candidate.answerReason: The chord length is \(2\sqrt{5^2-3^2}=8\), and the diameter is \(10\), giving a difference of \(2\).

methods.label: Bisect the chord
methods.explanation: The perpendicular from the center bisects the chord, so the Pythagorean theorem gives its half-length as \(\sqrt{5^2-3^2}=4\). The diameter is \(10\), the chord length is \(8\), and the difference is \(2\).
methods.levelReason: Perpendicular chord bisection and the Pythagorean theorem give a complete elementary solution.
